name: The Lovers
keywords: a choice the heart leans toward

facts.big-sun: At the very top, a large yellow sun sends out rays.
facts.angel-cloud: Under the sun, an angel with red wings and flame-like hair stands on a cloud with both arms spread.
facts.two-figures: A naked woman stands on the left and a naked man on the right, apart from each other.
facts.gazes: The woman looks up at the angel above, and the man looks toward the woman.
facts.fruit-tree-serpent: The tree behind the woman bears red fruit, and a green snake winds around its trunk.
facts.flame-tree: The tree behind the man bears fruit shaped like flames.
facts.mountain: Between the two, in the distance, a single pointed mountain rises.

glosses.gazes: They look in different places, which shows what each uses as the standard for choosing.
glosses.angel-cloud: A larger standard above the two that lights up the choice.
glosses.fruit-tree-serpent: Attraction comes with both temptation and the responsibility of choosing.

reversedGloss.blocked: They look in different directions, so the choice is put off.
reversedGloss.internalized: A promise to oneself needs to be settled before the relationship.
reversedGloss.excess: The pull is so strong that judgment becomes clouded.

misdescriptions.wrong: A man is torn between two women.
